gen-gf-k2d-fs-literata: Wide-mouthed and uniform, K2D draws its curves as heavy as its stems. And Literata, a text serif, brings a mellow thick-to-thin rhythm that gives the pair its real strength.
gen-gf-kaisei-decol-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps its curves generously apart from the stem, low in contrast and sharp in outline. Kaisei Decol hits hard with stencil-bold stems and hairlines.
gen-gf-kaisei-harunoumi-fs-bespoke-sans: Fat, heavy stems with wiry thin arms make Kaisei HarunoUmi unmistakable. Bespoke Sans then answers that drama with low contrast and refined, sharp restraint, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-kaisei-opti-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy strokes, then hairlines. Kaisei Opti swings hard between thick and thin, while Bespoke Sans stays low in contrast, sharp and refined, and that gap is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-kaisei-tokumin-fs-bespoke-sans: Dense ink-bar stems sit beside whisper-thin arcs in Kaisei Tokumin, a bookish, traditional look. Bespoke Sans counters with low contrast and wide gaps where curves meet stems, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-kalnia-fs-bespoke-sans: Kalnia sets thick verticals that dominate the line while its hairlines recede, giving a literary, editorial pull. Bespoke Sans does the opposite job best: sharp, low-contrast and refined.
gen-gf-kameron-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional in spirit, Kameron keeps real weight even at the thinnest points of its curves. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and low in contrast, gives the pair its strongest quality: a clear shift from sturdy serif to refined sans-serif.
gen-gf-kanchenjunga-fs-literata: Kanchenjunga looks like bent paperclip wire, a marker-like line with no swelling anywhere. Literata, a serif with slightly thinner tops on its round letters, would make that heading feel stiff if the heading were small.
gen-gf-kanit-fs-literata: Literata opens this pair as a classic serif with sturdy hairlines and slightly heavier strokes, bookish and sophisticated. And Kanit, plain and approachable, gives a longer stretch of that body room to read mellow and unhurried.
gen-gf-kantumruy-pro-fs-literata: Curves gape like a pried-open jar lid, drawn as if with ruler and compass. Kantumruy Pro keeps its line constant, while Literata, a classic serif, does best with a calm thick-thin swing.
